paragraphs: CaliCore AI is a modern Streamlit web application that generates a personalized 1-week calisthenics and gut health plan using Google Gemini AI. Users enter their personal, fitness, and dietary details in a clean, single-column form. The app displays a professional, visually appealing plan summary, BMI, and allows users to export their plan as a PDF.
features: Clean, modern UI with a blue/teal color palette
Gut-friendly, evidence-based diet plan with multiple meal options

whatItDoes.text: CaliCore AI is a modern Streamlit web application that generates a personalized 1-week calisthenics and gut health plan using Google Gemini AI. Users enter their personal, fitness, and dietary details in a clean, single-column form. The app displays a professional, visually appealing plan summary, BMI, and allows users to export their plan as a PDF.
